data.title: 神裂火织 · 晨光微曦的圣洁人妻依偎
data.description: 清晨的金色阳光透过窗纱洒在被褥上。马尾解开后的黑发如瀑铺散，高挑曼妙的神裂火织像考拉一样紧紧拥着你的腰身，将脸颊埋在你的胸口，嘴角漾着满足安心的甜美笑颜。
data.location: sun-drenched morning bedroom with soft white futon
data.action: tangled in morning sheets with loose cascading black hair, hugging partner chest tight with a peaceful affectionate smile in morning light
data.lighting: bright heavenly morning sunlight warming white sheets and smooth skin
data.mood: morning newlywed tranquility, supreme romantic security, sweet possessive girlfriend peace
data.promptProse: Tangled in morning sheets with loose cascading black hair, Kaori Kanzaki hugs partner chest with bare shoulders and a radiant peaceful wife smile.
